reason: A DeepSeek Harness WebUI plugin focused on automating DSH process restart and recovery through a UI button, local restart endpoint, and optional macOS launchd supervision.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 添加重启 DSH 按钮，并通过本地端点和 macOS launchd 守护支持进程重启与自动恢复。
summaries.en: Adds a Restart DSH button to the DeepSeek Harness WebUI and supports process restart and recovery through a local endpoint and optional macOS launchd supervision.

capabilities: Adds a WebUI control that stops and restarts the DSH web process
Exposes an HTTP restart endpoint and optional slash command
Installs a macOS launchd supervisor for automatic relaunch and login startup
Provides scripts and an AppleScript launcher for starting and controlling DSH
